evals.name: Detect session fixture requesting monkeypatch
evals.prompt: Audit a conftest.py file where a session-scoped fixture depends on monkeypatch and runs cleanup without try/finally.

assertions.description: Must flag session fixture requesting function-scoped monkeypatch.

evals.name: Verify clean try/finally fixture suite exits cleanly

assertions.description: Auditor exits 0 when scopes and teardowns are sound.
